 EPAM Romania
 EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer who will transform data into trusted, business-ready insights. You will work across the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, from data modeling and transformation in Databricks and dbt to delivering impactful dashboards and reports in Power BI. You will be a key contributor in our digital transformation journey, helping migrate and modernize our analytics landscape within a Databricks Medallion Architecture while ensuring stakeholders have access to reliable, actionable information. You are successful when your insights allow project managers and stakeholders to optimize costs, improve Agile performance, and achieve global targets.
 Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and Databricks to support reporting and analytics needs
Develop reliable data transformation processes and business logic, ensuring data is consistent, accurate, and well-documented
Design and optimize Power BI reports and dashboards using advanced DAX and Power Query to create meaningful business insights
Translate complex process, financial, and project portfolio data into actionable recommendations that support Enterprise Platforms' strategy
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business questions into data solutions
Support data ingestion and pipeline development using Databricks, SQL, and Python where appropriate
Improve data model performance, reporting efficiency, and overall analytics platform reliability
Identify data quality issues and implement controls, validations, and monitoring to improve trust in data
 Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a data-, analytics-, or technology-related field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering
Expertise in building and maintaining data models using dbt, including testing, documentation, and best practices for analytics engineering
Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX, data modeling, performance optimization, and dashboard design
Proficiency in SQL, with the ability to transform complex business requirements into efficient and maintainable data models
Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms, preferably within Microsoft Azure
Familiarity with Python for data processing, automation, and supporting data engineering activities when needed
Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders
Capability to work in a collaborative environment where team members contribute across a broad range of analytics and engineering activities
 Nice to have
Experience with financial data
Experience in Agile delivery environments
Experience in large-scale international organizations
